text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Here I go, Super Ultimate Move!! Pegasus 
Ultimate Screw!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: This running— This—surging thrill—!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: O-Oooooh, OOOOOOOOHHHHH!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: —I'm gonna blow right past them!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"A fierce pursuit! Narita Brian is in hot 
pursuit!! She's completely different from 
her last race! Such terrifying, demon-like 
running!!"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Even so! Crossing the line first is Biko 
Pegasus!! The tiny hero has taken down the 
strongest--!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... haa... Haaaaah...!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
My body... feels like it's gonna burst...! 
But Brian...! Brian...-san!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
This is—ultimate speed!! A full-power 
sprint burning through everything I have!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: —Kh!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
You really... did it now... Heheh... 
heheheh...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Yes, this is it... The scent of burning 
turf. A mutual shaving away—of life 
itself.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
At last... I can return. —To the path of 
carnage!
(UOOOOOH!!)

The overwhelming craze washed away the 
surging emotions in their respective 
hearts.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
“—Onto the next. Next time, we'll 
demonstrate that strength we pursue, right 
out on the turf.”

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: But Biko... With you, I—

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah! Good luck! Don't forget this 
present from a hero, alright?

Narita Brian walks away. Not with a 'see 
you later,' but a 'farewell.'

Both of them surely understood. There is 
no second chance in this match. That was 
what made it so special.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Brian... Looks like you've got a grasp on 
it. But...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
—Kh! It's so frustrating... Damn it, it's 
so vexing...!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I steeled my heart and gave it my 
all! And now, I understand.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Sometimes you have to cast aside kindness 
to save someone, huh. I feel like I've 
grown a little bit bigger!
choice_data_list:
Yeah, great work. And congratulations on 
the victory.

Yeah, good work. And congratulations on 
the win.

text_block_list.text:
I welcome her warmly. From now on, I want 
to help her walk the path of a righteous 
hero again as Justice Biko.

text_block_list.name: Young Woman & Akebono
text_block_list.text: Congratulations, Biko-chan!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Thank you, miss! Bono!

And then, at the victory party. After 
making a huge, joyous racket, Biko Pegasus 
was finally told about that matter.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Eh... No way...! Big sis, you're leaving 
already~?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I see... Can't be helped then! It's 
something worth celebrating after all!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Still... but aww...

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text:
I'll miss them too. But that doesn't mean 
we can just stop in our tracks, right?

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text:
I'll become a hero in America that won't 
lose to Biko-chan!

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text:
A hero who can save someone... No, someone 
who can do even more than that!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Miss... Yeah, you're right! We can 
definitely become even more amazing!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
This isn't my final form yet! I'm gonna 
aim to be an even more amazing hero!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Mm-hmm. You can do it, big sis! I'm 
cheering for you too!

text_block_list.name: Biko & Akebono
text_block_list.text: Bye-bye~! See ya~!

And so, she flew off to new horizons. Yet 
strangely enough, it didn't feel like a 
final farewell.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
All right, Trainer, moving on! Starting 
next race, we're aiming for a new form!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Not just being strong, and not just saving 
people, I'm going to be an even greater 
hero!
choice_data_list: Yeah, Biko's the one being chased now.

Yeah, Biko's the one being chased now, 
after all.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Being chased...! You're right. Now that 
I've won the Takamatsunomiya Kinen, the 
sprint monsters will come at me one after 
another!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Trainer. Then next is—

"—The Yasuda Kinen. A spring mile GⅠ that 
almost every sprint Umamusume aims for."

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
All right, then Justice Biko will 
intercept a new challenger right there!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Hm? Bono, what's up?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Um, you know... I was just thinking~... I 
kind of wish I could have taken on the 
challenge there myself~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
“Still, it's not bono at all yet. No 
matter how much I run, it doesn't help...”

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Ah... Right. Bono is still...

Zero wins in five races. Even with races 
where she was the first favorite, she has 
yet to meet expectations.

"At this rate, it looked like the day I'd 
race with my best friend Biko Pegasus was 
still a long, long way off..."

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Don't give up, Bono! That's right, 
we're... "Still just getting started—!"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"To become an even greater hero, I'll 
smash through that wall! So you give it 
your Dosukoi Power too, Bono!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeah...! You're right. Dosukoi, push 
push!

And so, the next phase begins. Cheering on 
Hishi Akebono along the way, Biko Pegasus 
headed toward the Yasuda Kinen.
